decisions.reason: The dumper was only mentioned on the website, so the commitment is weak and it sits close to the vehicle line that was cut after A and B, but listing it costs little while its value is still unresolved.
The inclined furniture lift had a page of its own and fits the firm's lifting know-how, and with no evidence of failure the cheap-to-hold option is worth keeping.
The building material lift shares design and service resources with the other inclined lifts, so carrying it costs little while construction demand keeps its prospects open.
The truck-mounted version costs somewhat more to keep, but it completes the lift family and nothing yet shows that its value will not be realized.
